q: The secret gathering of students engaging in violent initiation rituals, terrorizing campuses, and carrying illegal weapons is called ____. (P6)

q: The emergency telephone code used in Nigeria and many countries to reach police, ambulance, or fire services quickly is ____. (P6)
explain: 112 is the toll-free national emergency response center number.

q: The paramilitary security corps established in Nigeria to protect critical national infrastructure and monitor private security is ____. (P6)
explain: Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps guards pipelines, rail tracks, and schools.

q: Crime awareness (P6): What is Assault?
options: unlawfully using physical force or threatening violence against another person's body

q: Crime awareness (P6): What is Smuggling?
